financial_base.normalization_note: Midpoint of Okta's FY2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance ($3.90-$3.94) from Q2 FY2027 earnings release filed as 8-K exhibit on Aug 26, 2026. Non-GAAP EPS excludes stock-based compensation and other adjustments per company reconciliation. Forward-looking company guidance, not a historical GAAP figure from the 10-K. GAAP diluted EPS for FY2026 (year ended Jan 31, 2026) was $1.31 per the 10-K filed Mar 5, 2026; GAAP P/E of ~149x is distorted by significant stock-based compensation ($544M in FY2026). Forward non-GAAP P/E at $3.92 base = ~50x.
